name: anim_same_maw
subject: a pink paint goo shark monster with yellow marble streaks, its front half rising out of a paint puddle
desc: Very slowly and teasingly the shark opens its filthy mouth wider and wider: the jaw drops, thick sticky strands of goo and drool stretch between the upper and lower teeth, the gullet gurgles, the eyes leer. Slow, wet, sticky, dripping.
